Step 9/9-later Paige Cognetti   Cognetti, Oregon native, pads her resume, 
caters to liberal agenda to climb the ladder, 
absentee mayor, raised property taxes. Her 
political ambition paid for by taxpayers. 
What brought Paige to Scranton? “Politics”, 
in her own words.  
Love 9/16-later Paige Cognetti   Paige Cognetti knows that Scranton’s taxes 
are high, yet she won’t lower them.  Now she 
wants you to pay higher taxes AND she wants 
a higher office.  Cognetti loves getting ahead 
and moving up, no matter the cost. 
Don’t Get 9/26-later Paige Cognetti   Jeff, an owner of a mom & pop repair shop 
says Paige raises city taxes every year. She 
don’t care. Then she wants to go put all of 
the money into illegals. “I don’t get no free 
money.” All she is worried about is climbing 
and climbing the ladder.  Chryon:  “Helping 
Herself. Hurting Us.”
